Package com.nexuslink.protocol.ftp

Class FtpService

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.protocol.ftp.FtpService
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class FtpService extends Object implements AutoCloseable
FTP / FTPS client over Apache Commons Net. Connect with host/port + username/password (anonymous works with empty/"anonymous" credentials); passive mode and FTPS (explicit TLS) are supported.

    • uploadFrom

      public void uploadFrom(Path localSource, String remotePath, long offset, LongConsumer progress) throws Exception
      Uploads localSource from byte offset onward using FTP APPE, adding to the partial remote file. progress reports the remote file's total size (offset + bytes sent here). An offset of 0 delegates to the ordinary truncating upload(java.nio.file.Path, java.lang.String, java.util.function.LongConsumer).
      Throws:
      Exception

    • downloadFrom

      public void downloadFrom(String remotePath, Path localTarget, long offset, LongConsumer progress) throws Exception
      Downloads remotePath from byte offset onward using FTP REST, appending to the partial local file. Not every server honours REST — the offset is cleared afterwards either way so a later whole-file transfer is unaffected.
      Throws:
      Exception
